products.title: GMS Mobility Scooter Rear Seat Storage Bag (Extra large)
products.body_html:
The GMS Mobility Flexi (extra large) is a flexible mobility bag designed to be used on large and extra large-size wheelchairs, mobility scooters and powerchairs (images shown were taken on a Pride Ranger scooter).

This GMS super-sized Scooter bag is ideally suited to the largest mobility scooters on the market and bariatric wheelchairs and can fit a good grocery shop inside. Do not underestimate the size of the bag, please ensure it will fit between the pushing handles of your wheelchair and not obscure the lights on your scooter.

Constructed with a heavy-duty, waterproof, 1680 denier oxford it is considerably larger than the regular version, proving a popular choice for larger scooters and wheelchairs or those who simply like to carry more.

It also benefits from a simple fixing point at the base of the bag meaning that if you are a wheelchair user being pushed, your helper can secure the base of the bag together to prevent the bag from being in the way of their legs.

The Flexi extra large is a durable multipurpose bag with easy grip zip pulls, removable crutch/walking stick holders, and side storage pockets. The crutch/walking stick holders are large enough for the ferrules on NHS crutches and the popular Flexyfoot ferrules.

Everything about the extra large is supersized from the double-thickness velcro side fastenings for scooters to the double-thickness and super-sized buckles for fastening to your wheelchair.

It also boasts reflective trims for improved visibility, attractive handles, and distinctive grey trims.

Colour: Black
Code: FMBXL01
Size: H 57cm W 45cm D 15cm

GMS Mobility 5-Star Warranty Information
We pride ourselves here at GMS Mobility on aftercare. It’s the after-sales service that is most important when dealing with Mobility Scooters and Powerchairs.

What happens if I have a technical or operational issue within the warranty period?
You simply email or call us for assistance. We are on hand to help with absolutely any query or issue that you have with your product, from just wanting to go through the operational controls to help if you believe the item is faulty. We want to help!

What if my scooter or powerchair arrives faulty or develops a fault in the warranty period?
The chances are, we are not local to you but we strongly believe that we offer a faster and more efficient warranty turnaround than your local mobility store!

In the unlikely event that your scooter or powerchair develops a fault, you simply contact us and we will arrange for our trusted specialist collection firm to come to your door usually the very next day! We receive it back to our HQ in Colchester within a couple of working days where our engineer looks at it straight away. Our service department will aim to turn it around within 24-48 hours subject to having the parts in stock (if parts are needed). If we need to order a part, most manufacturers keep most in stock and in most cases, only takes a few days to arrive to us.

Is there a cost involved with collecting my Scooter or Powerchair?
No, we pay for the collection and delivery costs unless the return is due to user error. This will be rare as we do like to run through what is happening and see if we can resolve the issue over the phone first.

Do I need to package up my Scooter or Powerchair for the collection couriers?
No, we use a specialist firm that takes it away fully assembled so no need to do anything except make sure the charger is included, if possible.

products.title: 2025 Abilize Aethos SLE Lightweight Portable Mobility Scooter
products.body_html:
GMS Mobility are pleased to offer for sale this 07/2025 Ex Display Abilize Aethos SLE, a 4 mph super portable medium size mobility scooter which comes with the charger, fully tested lithium battery (in excellent order), user manual and a 6-month warranty. Ask us about Insurance, Extended Warranty and Part Exchange.

Some of the great features include suspension, a 25-mile range, 21 stone weight capacity, LED front and rear light, a swivel seat, solid tyres, on or off-board charging and comes apart into 5 parts (the heaviest part only 13.8kgs!) for easy transportation for cars, buses or trains!

The cosmetic condition is excellent!

Great price! (new price circa £3239.99)

FREE, fast nationwide delivery!

Manufacturers description:

The new ultra-lightweight Aethos SLE Mobility Scooter is a Which? Best Buy, boasting smart technology including lithium battery power and a luxuriously comfortable ride thanks to a completely redesigned seat. Forged from lightweight aluminium for effortless control, storage and transportability, designed right here in the UK and with a 5-year frame warranty for total peace of mind on the move, the Aethos is a challenge to the ethos of stuck-in-the-past mobility scooters

A Which? Best Buy Mobility Scooter

Hot on the heels of the Abilize Stride Sport, Stride Comforter and Aeron-Li, the Aethos Special Luxury Edition (SLE) promises a “smooth, controlled and comfortable ride, indoors and outdoors.” And with suspension to soak up unwanted jolts and shudders and a reimagined seat shaped for pinpoint pressure relief, you’ll definitely be able to sit back and enjoy all 25 miles of this scooter’s range in total comfort.

More power, more potential

With 25 miles on a full charge, this scooter is here to make your world bigger. Smaller, lighter and quicker to charge than standard batteries, the 30.15Ah lithium battery fitted in the Aethos SLE reduces the overall weight of the scooter without compromising on performance. Even the way you charge has been redesigned, with a tiller charging port available for quick and easy top-ups, as well as on and off board charging directly to the battery.

A lighter touch of luxury

With its completely redesigned seat, suspension and a delta tiller bar, the Aethos SLE turns up the dial to maximum comfort. The seat is contoured in all the right places and upholstered in premium breathable fabric. And like the frame itself, it manages to be lightweight without compromising on comfort. The suspension system protects you from potholed pavements and rugged terrain, while the delta tiller bar keeps you in control even if you’ve got limited hand strength. It’s a rare scooter that packs in features like that and still manages to weigh in at less than 45 kg fully assembled, but you’ll find it all on the Aethos.

The ethos of smart design

The Abilize Aethos SLE Travel Mobility Scooter uses the latest tech to make your every day that much easier. The concept and final design for the scooter was developed in the UK, with significant investment into the tooling also coming from the UK, so you can be sure of the quality of the build. The backlit touch screen puts all the controls at your fingertips. The smart armrests slide forwards and backwards, swing down for easy transfers and adjust to a comfortable height. It looks smart, too. The Aethos features updated alloys for a stylish touch, extra shrouding on the tiller bar and a choice of Aqua Green and Deep Bronze metallic finishes.

Overall a fantastic, comfortable small transportable folding scooter!

The Minimo Plus is the latest generation of compact, foldable mobility scooter design. Borrowing from the established heritage of the pioneering 4mph Minimo, it is extremely light weight and packed full of additional features. Its unique, single action folding mechanism can be operated with just one hand and requires no dismantling of parts or fiddly connections for compact storage in one easy motion.

Fitted as standard with cutting-edge lithium battery technology it is so lightweight, it can be lifted with one finger. The battery can be effortlessly removed for off-board charging allowing you to store the Minimo in a car boot for ultimate convenience.
The new Minimo Plus incorporates all these features along with additional features including larger pneumatic tyres, a more powerful motor and controller, integrated super bright maintenance free LED light, higher ground clearance and enhanced batteries. It also provides a rider weight capacity accommodating users weighing up to 115kg (250lbs).

The Minimo Plus folding car boot scooter delivers the ultimate driving experience and pushes mobility to a new level through the latest in assistive design.

The sturdy pneumatic tyres provide a smoother, more comfortable ride and extra range when compared to solid tyres and can include our puncture sealant for extra peace of mind. These tyres are combined with larger 228mm (9”) rear alloys so the Minimo Plus chassis provides a higher ground clearance of 70mm (2.8”). Fitted as standard with the reliable 70amp S-Drive controller and a 4 pole 270w motor the Minimo Plus has added performance whilst the Minimo’s market-leading manoeuvrability is retained. Its 820mm turning circle ensures driving around town and in shops is hassle-free and the Lithium-ion battery ensures a range of up to 15 miles (24km) on a single charge. Active rear suspension adds to the stability of the Minimo Plus and anti-tip side castors provide safety when negotiating uneven surfaces or lowered kerbs.

Despite all these extra features, the 25kg (55lbs) Minimo Plus remains easy-to-lift when folded for storage in the majority of car boots. The unlocking levers are quick to engage and once folded, Minimo can be effortlessly wheeled into position around the home.

products.title: Ex-Demo proLite Alluvium Portable Folding Electric Powerchair
products.body_html:
GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale this ex-demo proLite Alluvium Powerchair. FREE, fast nationwide delivery. Also comes with fully tested 12ah airline friendly lithium battery and charger (in excellent order), a user manual and 6-month warranty. Ask us about Insurance, Extended Warranty and Part Exchange.

Some of the great features include front suspension, up to 15 mile range, 18st 12lbs maximum user weight capacity, solid puncture proof tyres and off-board charging.

The mechanical and cosmetic condition is excellent 'as new'!

Great value as the new RRP is £1999.99+VAT!

Crafted from aerospace-grade aluminium and fitted with a futureproof lithium-ion battery, this lightweight powerchair pairs comfort with style and a sturdy design that’s built to last. The proLite Alluvium's stripped back design is proof that sometimes less really is more, with a frame forged from aerospace aluminium for a light carry weight but impressive control, comfort and strength.

The Alluvium is fitted with high performance lithium-ion batteries. We love lithium-ion batteries. For a start, they charge up to 25% quicker. The life cycle of the battery is up to 300% longer than a standard battery, too. And it’s 55% lighter, reducing the overall weight of your powerchair. Plus, with a range of 15 miles (24.3km), they help you spend less time charging and more time moving, day after day.

The Alluvium uses a remarkably simple push-pull folding frame, transforming the powerchair into a compact size for easy stowage. Ideal for hopping on and off public transport or sliding into a car boot, it also suits those who don’t want to deal with taking apart a bigger, heavier powerchair. The backrest’s push bar doubles as a handle when the Alluvium is folded, helpful for wheeling through busy train stations and airports.

This stylishly stripped-back lightweight design hides one big secret. It's still incredibly comfortable. The removable seat padding is contoured for superior pressure relief, so longer rides won't be a chore. It's fitted with front castor suspension to take rough and uneven ground in its stride without rattling your bones. And the larger rear wheels are fitted with flip-away anti-rollback wheels for safety on steep hills.

The rapid charging time is more than welcome if you’re heading out in a hurry, the longer life cycle means you get more charges before replacement, and the lighter weight makes off-board charging more convenient. The battery slots in under the seat in an easy to get to place, and it’s fitted with a charging socket right on the battery itself. It’s airline-safe as well, so if you love to travel, you’ll love the Alluvium.

Some of the great features include a fantastic turning circle, disassembles with the heaviest part being only 17.8kgs, a 21-stone weight capacity, an 18-mile range thanks to its 4-battery configuration, a comfortable padded seat with armrests included, 5-wheel anti-tip technology and can load into a car in just 60 seconds!

The ultra-portable Quingo Ultra makes lifting a car boot mobility scooter even easier and features flexible off vehicle charging
This is a take-apart, portable scooter which provides the perfect mobility solution for smaller spaces. It is ideal for use indoors or out, in shopping centres and other tight spaces, and it is easily transportable, dismantling to fit in the boot of a small car.

The Quingo Ultra is the most compact five-wheel scooter in the world, and every component part has been engineered to be as light as possible, using aluminium for the chassis and reflective silver ABS for the bodywork.

The Ultra is designed to dismantle with ease and to fit in to the boot of even smaller cars. The heaviest component is just 17.8kg or 39lbs and can be wheeled along with its own carry handle.

The off vehicle charging box allows you to charge two batteries at a time, allowing you to keep using the scooter with the two remaining batteries installed. All batteries can be charged using the onboard charging port when all four batteries are installed.

British-designed, combining manoeuvrability and ergonomics with stability

As with other scooters in the range, British designed five-wheel Quintell™ technology means that the Quingo Ultra combines the manoeuvrability and comfort of a three-wheeler with the stability of a four wheeled scooter. Quingo is the only scooter range that offers adaptive footplates and full ergonomic posture control, with fully adjustable seats and tillers, providing superior comfort even on longer journeys. The feet forward configuration gives up to 80% greater legroom than an equivalent four-wheel design which means taller customers, or those with stiff joints, can comfortably be catered for.

The Quingo Ultra is a 4mph pavement scooter, with a travel range of up to 18 miles on a single charge.

It features high security ignition system and the dash combines a speed limiter control and useful LED charge level indication lights.

The tiller includes and handy phone pocket and USB charging port.

products.title: CareCo Vorex 8 Mobility Scooter Buggy
products.body_html:
GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale this 2025 (sold new in 2026) CareCo Vorex 8 road- legal 4 to 8mph luxury all-terrain mobility scooter. This super smooth scooter comes with fully tested 50ah batteries (in excellent order), manual, a 5A charger and a 6-month warranty. Ask us about Insurance, Extended Warranty and Part Exchange.

Some of the great features include super soft front suspension, delta tiller, large pneumatic all-terrain wheels, super bright front and rear lights, 23 stone weight capacity & a luxury super comfortable swivel captain's seat and a 28-mile range!

The cosmetic condition is very good with the odd mark.

Great value as the new RPP is £2399.99+VAT!

Want to drive this scooter on the road? We can arrange the V5 logbook free of charge for you. Just message us after purchase.

The Vorex is a road-ready 8mph scooter built for comfort and confidence. The Vorex scooter gives you a smooth ride thanks to its suspension and strong pneumatic tyres, handling any ground with ease. The Vorex can be disassembled for easy storage or transport, making every trip, big or small, even more convenient. The steady delta tiller bar moves with the lightest touch, so you can go smoothly, safely, and in total control, wherever you're headed.

Whether you're navigating tough trails, or weaving through cobbled city streets, the Vorex delivers a ride that’s impressively smooth, thanks to its precision-engineered suspension system. The ergonomic, ultra-cushioned leather seat alleviates pressure on long rides, keeping you comfy from start to finish. Practical, reliable, and built for life on the move, the Vorex makes every journey feel effortless.

The Vorex 8mph scooter gives you the freedom to go further, with comfort and confidence built in. The Vorex’s pneumatic tyres are perfect for tough terrain. They don't just give you a smoother ride over every little bump, their deep tread also means they can properly grip onto all sorts of surfaces. So, even if you hit a bit of mud or gravel, you won't get stuck – the Vorex just keeps on going, giving you more confidence to explore.

Steering the Vorex feels effortless, thanks to an ergonomic delta tiller that offers a natural, comfortable grip. You only need a light push with your thumb or finger to get going, which means less strain on your hands and wrists, even during longer rides. It’s ideal if your grip isn’t what it once was or if you just want something that’s easier to control, so you can reach your destination without worrying about the journey.

GMS Mobility 5-Star Warranty Information

We pride ourselves here at GMS Mobility on aftercare. It’s the after-sales service that is most important when dealing with Mobility Scooters and Powerchairs.

What happens if I have a technical or operational issue within the warranty period?

You simply email or call us for assistance. We are on hand to help with absolutely any query or issue that you have with your product, from just wanting to go through the operational controls to help if you believe the item is faulty. We want to help!

What if my scooter or powerchair arrives faulty or develops a fault in the warranty period?

The chances are, we are not local to you but we strongly believe that we offer a faster and more efficient warranty turnaround than your local mobility store!

In the unlikely event that your scooter or powerchair develops a fault, you simply contact us and we will arrange for our trusted specialist collection firm to come to your door usually the very next day! We receive it back to our HQ in Colchester within a couple of working days where our engineer looks at it straight away. Our service department will aim to turn it around within 24-48 hours subject to having the parts in stock (if parts are needed). If we need to order a part, most manufacturers keep most in stock and in most cases, only takes a few days to arrive to us.

Is there a cost involved with collecting my Scooter or Powerchair?

No, we pay for the collection and delivery costs unless the return is due to user error. This will be rare as we do like to run through what is happening and see if we can resolve the issue over the phone first.

Do I need to package up my Scooter or Powerchair for the collection couriers?

No, we use a specialist firm that takes it away fully assembled so no need to do anything except make sure the charger is included, if possible.

products.body_html:
This Mobility Plus+ Navigator portable mobility scooter came to us via a part exchange and is being sold fully tested to clear at a bargain price and with a 3 month warranty.

The MobilityPlus+ Navigator is designed to be the perfect everyday mobility scooter. Sleek, Sporty and packed with features - the Navigator has everything you need for smooth and comfortable travel. 

Benefit from an impressive range of 16 miles with the 20Ah battery. Large 9” front and rear wheels and a ground clearance of 3.5” offer upgraded ride comfort and the ability to tackle tougher terrain. For outdoor journeys, the all-around suspension system protects against pavement bumps and provides a smooth ride throughout. Solid, anti-friction tyres ensure you stay puncture-free.

A delta tiller bar ensures the user remains comfortable and in control at all times - even those with Arthritis or other restrictive conditions. A speed dial is incorporated into the tiller panel which lets you adapt the speed to your surroundings; Simply dial it down to the Tortoise icon to go slower, or turn it up to the Hare to reach maximum speed. 

Tool-free and quick disassembly lets you break down the scooter into 5 lightweight pieces - with the heaviest part just 17.5kg. Whether you’re putting the scooter into your car or storing it away at home, you’ll find this model highly portable. 

A padded 360° swivel seat helps transferring in and out of the scooter. The seat also slides forwards and backwards if required so you are sure to find the perfect driving position. Padded armrests are width-adjustable.

A spacious detachable storage basket is fitted to the front of the scooter for all of your shopping and personal items. Built-in high intensity LED pavement lights are fitted at the front for whenever they're required. 

Charging the Navigator scooter is simple, either plug the charger into the tiller head or remove the battery and charge directly.

products.title: CareCo Zoom Portable Mobility Scooter Buggy
products.body_html:
GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale this pre-loved 2022 CareCo Zoom, 4 mph transportable mobility scooter buggy which comes with fully tested 20ah batteries, charger, Free delivery, user manual and a 6-month warranty. Ask us about Insurance and Part Exchange. 

Some of the great features include a 10 mile range thanks to its smaller lightweight battery pack (the Zoom Plus does slightly more miles but is a much heavier battery pack), comfortable padded swivel seat, solid tyres, on or off board charging and comes apart into 5 parts for easy transportation for cars, buses, trains and planes!

The cosmetic condition is very good with a few marks (please see images).

FREE, fast nationwide delivery!

This nimble and stylish scooter is the first of a new generation that brings unprecedented convenience and independence to those who need mobility support. With its sturdy 8 inch wheels and 10 mile battery range, it looks and performs much like other scooters but with one difference – at a single pull of a lever, it separates into five manageable parts, ideal for storing out of the way or loading into the car.

If you enjoy going places in your car and need a mobility aid when you arrive at you destination, you'll want something light so you can get it in and out of the boot without assistance. Until recently, that would have ruled out a mobility scooter – but the CareCo Zoom has rewritten the rule book. The Zoom splits at a single stroke into five lightweight parts and is just as easy to reassemble.

Whether you're shopping, socialising or just getting out of the house for a while, the Zoom is the ideal mobility aid for trouble free travel. The eight inch wheels have treaded puncture-proof tyres that will negotiate changes in surface with ease, while the narrow wheelbase and precision steering are perfect in a busy shopping centre. There’s even a horn to alert daydreamers of your presence!

When the time comes to recharge the battery on your CareCo Zoom, the process is made extra straightforward by the scooter’s off-board charging facility. This means you can simply lift out the entire battery box, take it indoors and plug it into the mains. It makes charging hassle-free as there’s no need to manoeuvre the scooter itself up close to a power outlet - at least, not unless you really want to!

A mobility scooter can be your gateway to freedom and independence when your mobility is not what it once was. For this reason, it can be a wrench to go somewhere without it, and suddenly be reliant on others for a helping hand. With the Zoom, that never has to happen. It’s so light and portable, you can literally take it anywhere, whether you’re visiting family or treating yourself to a weekend away.

Manufacturers description:

The Quingo Toura2 is the most advanced and powerful 4/8 mph road legal model and the perfect mobility solution for those who wish to go further with more power, carrying capacity and range. It’s the ultimate endurance model, and a stylish car replacement with its larger wheels, motor and extra long range batteries. It comes with all the Quingo benefits of stability, manoeuvrability, comfort, kerb climbing and safety as standard.

Only Quingo has the unique 5-wheel stability system. This enhanced design feature allows Quingo scooters to use far less space when making a tight turn – without fear of tipping or falling, all whilst allowing enhanced control when negotiating dips and bumps. Ideal indoors or out, it can be used around your local neighbourhood, for shopping trips or even for a stroll in the park. So say goodbye to tipping and multi-point turns and say hello to the Quingo. Appreciate the blend of comfort, performance and portability. The Quingo Toura2 offers versatility not found in traditional scooters with its amazing handling, superior safety and comfort all in a single mobility scooter.

The Quingo Toura2 comes with a unique long travel suspension system to the rear of the vehicle that is adjustable so you can get a softer or harder ride by adjusting the settings. This is adjustable to your weight and wishes for optional suspension and comfort.

Total comfort all starts with your posture. Quingo is the only scooter range that offers full ergonomic posture control. By reducing stress on your back, hips, knees and ankle joints you can enjoy even the longest journeys. The seat itself can swivel and lock at 45 degree angles, meaning you can approach a desk, or table and even work from the product. With our free test drive you can experience just how good a Quingo feels for yourself. The Quingo Toura2 has a wide double padded high back ergonomic seat with extended easy access seat slide, meaning an even more comfortable ride.

Quingo is the only range of mobility scooters that features adaptive footplates and allows for full ergonomic posture control, affording exceptional comfort, even on those lengthy excursions. The feet forward configuration of Quingo allows customers of a loftier stature, and those who may suffer from joint stiffness, to ride comfortably. The Quingo Toura2 is also fitted with the next generation adaptive footplates with “Venous return”, which assists clients with conditions such as Lymphedema.

As soon as you switch on the Toura2, daytime running lights automatically turn on which is a great safety feature and this doesn’t use a lot of battery charge so you don’t need to worry about this. If you are out at night or dusk you can switch on the main headlight and rear lights at the back of the vehicle. When you start to slow down or go to stop, a reversing light will also be illuminated to warn people behind you.

The Quingo Toura2 has a plethora of features and benefits, such as a digital display with night illumination, speedo, milometer, temperature gauge, easy to use controls and even a 12V power socket to help you power your Sat Nav or mobile. products.title: Li-Tech Air Plus + Lightweight Portable Mobility Scooter
products.body_html:
GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale this 2025 Li-Tech AIR + (Plus), a 4 mph super portable, lightweight, long-range mobility scooter that comes with fully tested 20ah lithium battery (in excellent order - 28.9v), charger, user manual and a 6-month warranty. Ask us about insurance and part exchange! 

Some of the great features include suspension, a 12-mile range, a 21-stone weight capacity, a swivel seat, solid tyres, on or off-board charging and comes apart into 5 parts (heaviest part only 15kgs!) for easy transportation for cars, buses and trains!

The cosmetic condition is very good with some minor marks.

This portable scooter ticks all the boxes in our opinion!

FREE, fast nationwide delivery!

Manufacturers description:

The future has arrived and we like what we see! The Li-Tech Air Plus represents a new generation of mobility scooters. It’s lighter, better performing and faster to charge than anything that’s come before it, and it is all thanks to the lithium battery power at its heart. As well as the lighter weight and faster charging time, lithium-ion batteries last longer and deliver consistent performance even at low charge.

Lithium-ion technology is driving change across many areas of transport, and mobility aids are no exception. These power cells provide performance that is on another level compared with lead acid batteries. Small, light and with a faster charging time, they also deliver consistent performance regardless of the level of charge - so a battery that has two percent charge is just as powerful as one that is fully charged.

Intelligently designed for your comfort

Everything about the Li-Tech Air has been designed with your comfort and convenience in mind. The plush seat is generously padded and height adjustable, and it swivels to the side to make boarding and alighting as easy and safe as possible. Out and about, it’s incredibly easy to operate, even if you have limited grip and dexterity, thanks to large controls with great sensitivity. It’s ideal for those living with arthritis.


A smoother ride wherever you go

Li-Tech has taken the unusual step of incorporating all-round independent suspension on the Air. At least, it’s an unusual feature on a travel scooter. You'll really notice the difference as rattles and bumps are absorbed, and if you usually find travel scooters too uncomfortable due to vibrations being transmitted up your spine and leaving you black and blue, this one is definitely something you should try.

Perfect for regular trips in the car

The Air can be split into five components in no time, and it's just as easy to reassemble when you arrive at your destination. The heaviest part weighs a mere 15kg (33lb) so it’s manageable if you are travelling on your own. The design makes it easy to store out of the way when it’s not in use, too. Off-board charging means you can leave the scooter packed away while you take the battery pack indoors to charge.

products.title: iConnect Zora Carbon Electric Wheelchair Powerchair - Only 12.7kgs!
products.body_html:
GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale this 2022 Zora Carbon Fibre Portable Powerchair. This is the world's lightest powerchair (12.7kgs!) but still has all the features that you would expect from a powerchair. Ask us about Insurance, Extended Warranty and Part Exchange.

It includes the (tested) airline-friendly 10AH Lithium battery, solid tyres, supportive leg strap, transferable joystick (can be on either the left or right side), user manual and charger. FREE, fast national delivery, mail-order part exchange available and a 6-month warranty that covers everything!

The cosmetic condition is very good with just the odd mark.

The lightest powerchair in the world! Coming in at a featherweight 12.7 kg, the Zora Carbon Powerchair weighs less than some manual wheelchairs but it pulls no punches when it comes to packing in the features. This groundbreaking lightweight powerchair takes its cues from the world of road bikes, with a frame crafted from carbon fibre for optimum strength and durability. And with airline-friendly batteries and quick and easy folding, this is one powerchair that really can go with you wherever you need it to.

Expert engineering and the latest technology means this powerchair weighs less than any other you’ll find on the market. The frame is made up entirely of carbon fibre, chosen for its impressive strength to weight ratio. Five-times stronger than steel and twice as stiff, it also resists corrosion and it doesn’t fatigue over time. The higher compression strength of carbon fibre coupled with the reinforced seat panel means that despite its lightweight build, this powerchair still supports up to 120 kg in weight. In short? The Zora is the way to go if you want a powerchair that will last.

That carbon fibre frame isn’t just functional – it looks extra special too. The Zora has a minimalist design but it maxes out the style, with the black-flecked carbon fibre frame looking smoother and sleeker than aluminium powerchairs. The half-folding backrest is perfect for quick and easy storage at home and stowage on planes, trains and automobiles, while the magnesium alloy wheels add yet another touch of class.

The Zora Carbon holds up just as well outdoors as it does gliding around indoors. The expertly engineered carbon fibre frame counteracts the discomfort of tough outdoor terrain like kerbs and cobbles, and the solid tyres mean there’s no chance of a puncture ruining your day. Flip up armrests allow for easier side transfers and the aerated backrest relieves pressure for longer journeys. The cushions are removable, too, so you can wash them when you need to.

The Zora Carbon houses a 10AH lithium-ion battery that charges quicker, lasts longer and weighs less than SLA batteries. You’ll get 15 km on a full charge – but the batteries are light enough that you could carry a spare and double up your range. On- and off-board charging add to the convenience, and at 240 watt hours it can be taken on a plane (but it’s always worth checking with your airline before flying).

Our new quick-folding, car boot-convenient lightweight mobility scooter. The X-Go TravelPro folds almost flat to fit where bigger scooters can’t, ideal for public transport and compact storage. 17.4 miles of uninterrupted travel.

The cosmetic condition is very good with minor mark on the footplate.

Great value as the new RRP is £2299+VAT!

Lightweight, lithium powered travel

With a heaviest piece of 21.5kg and a lithium-ion battery that weighs less than the sealed lead acid batteries on other models, the TravelPro makes everyday life with a scooter not just brighter, but lighter, too. Thoughtfully designed and cleverly built, this travel scooter folds almost to an almost flat 12” clearance with the seat removed – slide it into your car boot for days out, or an out-the-way storage space for days in. Plus, enjoy the peace of mind that comes with a lifetime warranty on the frame, keeping you on the move day in, day out.

Clever convenience

The X-Go TravelPro is expertly engineered to fit neatly into your everyday life. On the move, you’ll feel comfortable and stable every mile of the day. And when you need to pack it up for transport, it takes just a few seconds to drop the seat hinges and tiller bar. Integrated handles at the front and sides of the scooter mean you can wheel it along like a suitcase, and the weight of the scooter is distributed evenly – a massive help when you’re hoisting it into a car boot. Once the front wheels are on the car, just lift the back and wheel it into your boot. Safe, simple, car boot convenience.

You’re in control

With a small turning radius and simple tiller bar operation, the TravelPro keeps you in control. Narrow spaces, busy high streets and train stations are easy to deal with, while longer journeys are back on the cards thanks to the 17.4-mile high performance lithium-ion battery. There’s no shortage of comfort either – the tiller bar is infinitely adjustable thanks to the gas-strut design, so you can bring it closer or move it further away depending on the room you need, while the armrests can be moved to help you on and off the scooter seat with ease.

Expand your horizons

The high-intensity LED headlight lights the way when you’re out after dark, with a horn to keep you safe in busy areas.

products.body_html:
This great value 2024 X-Go Nano comes in excellent condition as you would expect, and includes a fully tested lithium battery (in excellent order - 29.2v) and charger, free delivery, a user manual and a 3-month warranty. What a brilliant design! Ask us about insurance and part exchange available.

The latest addition to the X-Go range combines hands-free folding for effortless portability with clever features that make everyday travel so much easier. We’re talking automatic front and rear lights, fully adjustable tiller controls and delivers a range of 6.8 miles (11KM) – and at just 25KG (55lb), the whole thing weighs about the same as the suitcase you take on your holidays.

The cosmetic and mechanical condition is excellent with scrapes underneath the rear.

Great value as the new RRP is £2099.99+VAT!

Go anywhere and take it anywhere 

The X-Go Nano is the perfect fit for a life on the go. The simple automatic folding mechanism and lightweight build mean you can take it anywhere, either in the boot of the car or on public transport. And when you arrive at your destination, you’ve got everything you need to explore as you please.

Freedom for independent living

Don’t let limited mobility limit your sense of adventure. The X-Go Nano is a mobility scooter that you can literally take with you anywhere. When fully folded, it fits easily into the car, bus, train or even plane. The extra trolley wheels mean you can pull it along like a small wheeled suitcase when not in use. Then unfold it in seconds with one quick click.

Small in stature, big on features

You’ll enjoy your generously padded seat with spring loaded backrest that automatically folds down when you leave the scooter, as well as the larger wheels that tackle tough terrain. A useful but straightforward LED display gives you all the information you need at a glance, such as your speed and the battery charge level.

Safe and easy for anyone to operate

Tiller controls and regenerative braking combine to make the X-Go Nano safe and simple to operate, even for those with restricted grip. The throttle and braking can be accurately controlled with the lightest touch, and the speed limiter helps you stay in complete control at all times. Sensor-operated lights ensure you can see and be seen. Light but sturdy, it can accommodate users weighing up to 115KG (18 stone). Nano Travel bag available.

The ultra-portable Quingo Ultra makes lifting a car boot mobility scooter even easier and features flexible off vehicle charging
This is a take-apart, portable scooter which provides the perfect mobility solution for smaller spaces. It is ideal for use indoors or out, in shopping centres and other tight spaces, and it is easily transportable, dismantling to fit in the boot of a small car.

The Quingo Ultra is the most compact five-wheel scooter in the world, and every component part has been engineered to be as light as possible, using aluminium for the chassis and reflective silver ABS for the bodywork.

The Ultra is designed to dismantle with ease and to fit in to the boot of even smaller cars. The heaviest component is just 17.8kg or 39lbs and can be wheeled along with its own carry handle.

The off vehicle charging box allows you to charge two batteries at a time, allowing you to keep using the scooter with the two remaining batteries installed. All batteries can be charged using the onboard charging port when all four batteries are installed.

British-designed, combining manoeuvrability and ergonomics with stability

As with other scooters in the range, British designed five-wheel Quintell™ technology means that the Quingo Ultra combines the manoeuvrability and comfort of a three-wheeler with the stability of a four wheeled scooter. Quingo is the only scooter range that offers adaptive footplates and full ergonomic posture control, with fully adjustable seats and tillers, providing superior comfort even on longer journeys. The feet forward configuration gives up to 80% greater legroom than an equivalent four-wheel design which means taller customers, or those with stiff joints, can comfortably be catered for.

The Quingo Ultra is a 4mph pavement scooter, with a travel range of up to 18 miles on a single charge.

It features high security ignition system and the dash combines a speed limiter control and useful LED charge level indication lights.

The tiller includes and handy phone pocket and USB charging port.

Coming in at a featherweight 12.7 kg, the Zora Carbon Powerchair weighs less than some manual wheelchairs but it pulls no punches when it comes to packing in the features. This groundbreaking lightweight powerchair takes its cues from the world of road bikes, with a frame crafted from carbon fibre for optimum strength and durability. Manufacturers description:

The future has arrived and we like what we see! The Li-Tech Air Plus represents a new generation of mobility scooters. It’s lighter, better performing and faster to charge than anything that’s come before it, and it is all thanks to the lithium battery power at its heart. As well as the lighter weight and faster charging time, lithium-ion batteries last longer and deliver consistent performance even at low charge.

Lithium-ion technology is driving change across many areas of transport, and mobility aids are no exception. These power cells provide performance that is on another level compared with lead acid batteries. Small, light and with a faster charging time, they also deliver consistent performance regardless of the level of charge - so a battery that has two percent charge is just as powerful as one that is fully charged.

Intelligently designed for your comfort

Everything about the Li-Tech Air has been designed with your comfort and convenience in mind. The plush seat is generously padded and height adjustable, and it swivels to the side to make boarding and alighting as easy and safe as possible. Out and about, it’s incredibly easy to operate, even if you have limited grip and dexterity, thanks to large controls with great sensitivity. It’s ideal for those living with arthritis.


A smoother ride wherever you go

Li-Tech has taken the unusual step of incorporating all-round independent suspension on the Air. At least, it’s an unusual feature on a travel scooter. You'll really notice the difference as rattles and bumps are absorbed, and if you usually find travel scooters too uncomfortable due to vibrations being transmitted up your spine and leaving you black and blue, this one is definitely something you should try.

Perfect for regular trips in the car

The Air can be split into five components in no time, and it's just as easy to reassemble when you arrive at your destination. The heaviest part weighs a mere 15kg (33lb) so it’s manageable if you are travelling on your own. The design makes it easy to store out of the way when it’s not in use, too. Off-board charging means you can leave the scooter packed away while you take the battery pack indoors to charge.

The Enzo 8 is designed to negotiate the toughest terrain with ease. The powerful motor can tackle steep gradients of up to 10 percent while the large 14 inch wheels are fitted with tough pneumatic tyres that will get you through just about anything. The battery has a 25-30 mile range so you can explore to your heart’s content, and the super-comfy captain seat makes every mile a pleasure, not an endurance test!

With the Enzo 8, your ability to explore doesn't have to be constrained by mobility limitations. This hardy but comfortable scooter is fully equipped for road use, but is a capable performer on rougher terrain too. If you love to get out in nature, there’s nothing to stop you. Those large pneumatic tyres mean business and the suspension system will ensure that you still enjoy a smooth ride, wherever you may roam.

A sleek and modern build makes the Enzo 8 look like a scooter that is ready for serious road-based adventures, and it has all the equipment you need to meet any challenge, such as lights, indicators and a horn. It's equally capable around town, on pavements or even around the shops. The control panel includes a speed limiter that you can set to tortoise in crowds, then use the full 8mph capability on the road home.

That plush captain seat feels as comfy as it looks, and it is backed up by a full suspension system and large pneumatic tyres. It all combines to deliver the smoothest ride you’re likely to find from any scooter on the market. It’s ideal if you have fragile bones and joints or a condition like fibromyalgia, and it means travel once again becomes an adventure to be enjoyed, not a trial to be endured.

Despite the long list of specifications, the Enzo 8 is easy for anyone to operate. Everything is controlled from a central panel, where you’ll find large and clearly marked switches for the indicators, lights and so on, as well as an LCD display telling you how much power is remaining in the battery. With a delta tiller for steering and paddles for throttle and brake, it can all be operated with a light touch.

This comfortable and stylish entry into the I-Go premium range boasts a range of features that make it one of the best performing powerchairs both around the house and venturing further afield. Manufacturers description:

The Quingo Toura2 is the most advanced and powerful 4/8 mph road legal model and the perfect mobility solution for those who wish to go further with more power, carrying capacity and range. It’s the ultimate endurance model, and a stylish car replacement with its larger wheels, motor and extra long range batteries. It comes with all the Quingo benefits of stability, manoeuvrability, comfort, kerb climbing and safety as standard.

Only Quingo has the unique 5-wheel stability system. This enhanced design feature allows Quingo scooters to use far less space when making a tight turn – without fear of tipping or falling, all whilst allowing enhanced control when negotiating dips and bumps. Ideal indoors or out, it can be used around your local neighbourhood, for shopping trips or even for a stroll in the park. So say goodbye to tipping and multi-point turns and say hello to the Quingo. Appreciate the blend of comfort, performance and portability. The Quingo Toura2 offers versatility not found in traditional scooters with its amazing handling, superior safety and comfort all in a single mobility scooter.

The Quingo Toura2 comes with a unique long travel suspension system to the rear of the vehicle that is adjustable so you can get a softer or harder ride by adjusting the settings. This is adjustable to your weight and wishes for optional suspension and comfort.

Total comfort all starts with your posture. Quingo is the only scooter range that offers full ergonomic posture control. By reducing stress on your back, hips, knees and ankle joints you can enjoy even the longest journeys. The seat itself can swivel and lock at 45 degree angles, meaning you can approach a desk, or table and even work from the product. With our free test drive you can experience just how good a Quingo feels for yourself. The Quingo Toura2 has a wide double padded high back ergonomic seat with extended easy access seat slide, meaning an even more comfortable ride.

Quingo is the only range of mobility scooters that features adaptive footplates and allows for full ergonomic posture control, affording exceptional comfort, even on those lengthy excursions. The feet forward configuration of Quingo allows customers of a loftier stature, and those who may suffer from joint stiffness, to ride comfortably. The Quingo Toura2 is also fitted with the next generation adaptive footplates with “Venous return”, which assists clients with conditions such as Lymphedema.

As soon as you switch on the Toura2, daytime running lights automatically turn on which is a great safety feature and this doesn’t use a lot of battery charge so you don’t need to worry about this. If you are out at night or dusk you can switch on the main headlight and rear lights at the back of the vehicle. When you start to slow down or go to stop, a reversing light will also be illuminated to warn people behind you.

The Quingo Toura2 has a plethora of features and benefits, such as a digital display with night illumination, speedo, milometer, temperature gauge, easy to use controls and even a 12V power socket to help you power your Sat Nav or mobile. The Toura2 also has 2 100amphour batteries allowing the product to travel up to 55 miles on a single charge.

Thanks to the use of plastic materials, the basket is lightweight and resistant to dents. In addition, it is attached to the chassis instead of the steering column, so that the Quingo scooter is not heavy to steer.

products.body_html:
GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale this ex-demo 2024 proLite Alluvium Powerchair that comes with fully tested 12ah airline friendly lithium battery and charger (in excellent order), a user manual and 6-month warranty. Ask us about Insurance and Part Exchange.

Some of the great features include front suspension, up to 15 mile range, 18st 12lbs maximum user weight capacity, solid puncture proof tyres and off-board charging.

Crafted from aerospace-grade aluminium and fitted with a futureproof lithium-ion battery, this lightweight powerchair pairs comfort with style and a sturdy design that’s built to last. The proLite Alluvium's stripped back design is proof that sometimes less really is more, with a frame forged from aerospace aluminium for a light carry weight but impressive control, comfort and strength.

The Alluvium is fitted with high performance lithium-ion batteries. We love lithium-ion batteries. For a start, they charge up to 25% quicker. The life cycle of the battery is up to 300% longer than a standard battery, too. And it’s 55% lighter, reducing the overall weight of your powerchair. Plus, with a range of 15 miles (24.3km), they help you spend less time charging and more time moving, day after day.

The Alluvium uses a remarkably simple push-pull folding frame, transforming the powerchair into a compact size for easy stowage. Ideal for hopping on and off public transport or sliding into a car boot, it also suits those who don’t want to deal with taking apart a bigger, heavier powerchair. The backrest’s push bar doubles as a handle when the Alluvium is folded, helpful for wheeling through busy train stations and airports.

This stylishly stripped-back lightweight design hides one big secret. It's still incredibly comfortable. The removable seat padding is contoured for superior pressure relief, so longer rides won't be a chore. Expand your horizons

Possibly the most comfortable to drive medium-to-large size scooters!

Want to drive this scooter on the road? No problem. Contact us after purchase and we will register it with the DVLA free of charge!

Free nationwide delivery!

Manufacturers description:

5 wheel Anti-Tip Technology

Only Quingo has the unique 5-wheel stability system offering exceptional stability, agility, safety and comfort. This enhanced design feature allows Quingo scooters to use far less space when making a tight turn – without fear of tipping or falling, all whilst allowing enhanced control when negotiating dips and bumps. Ideal indoors or out, it can be used around your local neighbourhood, for shopping trips or even for a stroll in the park. So say goodbye to tipping and multi-point turns and say hello to the Quingo. Appreciate the blend of comfort, performance and portability.

• Unrivalled agility and a tighter turning circle – In independent research carried out by Thorpe Associates the 5 wheel Quingo proved to be more manoeuvrable than any 4 wheel scooter, of comparable length, available today. This makes for agility, while maintaining safety, in places with restricted space such as small shops and shopping centres.

• No ordinary portable mobility scooter – Enhanced 5 wheel stability. The first generation, 3 wheel portable mobility scooters, while agile, are unable to match 4 wheel portables when it comes to stability. Using British designed 5 wheel Quintell™ technology makes for unrivalled stability, crucial for negotiating hills and slopes and when mounting or descending kerbs

• Enhanced comfort & posture control – Being able to achieve a healthy posture is a vital consideration when choosing any mobility vehicle. Quingo is the only range of mobility scooters that feature adaptive footplates and allow for full ergonomic posture control, affording exceptional comfort even on those lengthy excursions. The feet forward configuration of Quingo allows customers of a loftier stature, and those who may suffer joint stiffness, to be accommodated in comfort in a portable vehicle measuring only 107 cm in length.

• Safer kerb handling – even at angles. Kerbs can represent considerable obstacle to scooter users. Only the Quingo 5 wheel system features the capability to ascend and descend kerbs at an angle of up tp 45°. Additionally Quingo’s patented Kerbmaster not only prevents tipping but also eliminates beaching with it’s auto-powered drive system.

• Automatic regenerative braking, automatic electromagnetic parking

GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale, this 2023 CareCo Maximus, a brilliant transportable 4 mph pavement mobility scooter that comes with fully tested charger and lithium battery (in excellent order), user manual, 1 key and a 6-month warranty included. Ask us about Insurance and Part Exchange.

Some of the great features include an 18-stone weight capacity, 7.5-inch puncture-proof tyres, a 25-mile range, one of the lightest folding scooters in the UK (22kgs) and is ideal for car boots, buses or trains!

The mechanical and cosmetic condition is excellent!

FREE national courier delivery!

Compact made clever. The bigger brother to the incredibly popular Minimus is here, kitted out with a collection of features to help you move better, feel better and live better. The Maximus is an expression of progressive functional design, powered by the future thanks to its lithium-ion battery with off board charging and built to boost your freedom with its quick-fold, vertically storable frame. Enjoy maximum freedom and maximum potential with the Maximus Folding Mobility Scooter.

Maximum freedom, minimal fuss

Nothing makes travel easy like the Maximus. On the move, you’ll feel the benefit of a padded seat with integrated swing-away armrests, plus an LCD delta tiller bar that needs just one finger to get going. Your digital display shows you all the key info, with big buttons to toggle the light on and off, increase and decrease your speed and sound your horn. And with larger 7.5” puncture-proof tyres and a higher ground clearance, the Maximus goes where the Minimus might struggle. The Maximus was created in collaboration with one of the world’s best medical products manufacturers in Taiwan, who work to BSI (British Standards Institution) standards to ensure that it meets their specifications in design and safety.

Quick folding for slick storage

The Maximus only needs just 5 easy movements to get the frame folded. With the tiller down, the seat removed and the footplate section folded up you can tow the scooter behind you using the extendable handle and stand it on its end for space saving storage. The basket is removable and foldable too, saving even more space when you’re packing up. With the battery removed, the carry weight of the Maximus is just 22kg, with a carry handle at the rear and a recessed front to help you lift the scooter up and into a car boot or luggage compartment on public transport.

Lighter, longer lasting battery power

The Maximus is fitted with a 27.6Ah lithium-ion battery for improved performance, charging times and durability. The 25 mile range makes your world bigger, and it’s so light and easy to fit that you could even carry a spare with you to double your mileage. The battery slots in under the seat and can be charged away from the scooter or on-board through the tiller charging port. The carry handle makes it easy to remove and carry inside for charging – a great feature for those who store their scooter either outdoors or in a shed or garage.

Built to boost your independence

The Maximus might be the bigger brother to the Minimus, but there’s no sibling rivalry here. Both scooters are built to be cleverly compact, with smart designs to make your everyday life easier. Find a compromise that works for you, whether you need the ultra-slim profile of the UK’s lightest folding mobility scooter, or you feel like a little more comfort will go a long way with the Maximus. One thing’s for sure: you won’t be losing out on style. The Maximus Folding Mobility Scooter comes in Metallic Crimson or Onyx, for a design that’s as good to look at as it is to drive.

Whether you're off into town or traveling further afield, this mobility scooter keeps every journey simple and stress-free. A high-low speed switch and easy speed adjustment buttons let you move from pavement to roads and back again, while the 80Ah battery offers an impressive 30 miles on a full charge and the powerful 850W motor takes on any challenge.

The Corvus Rapide handles better than other 6-8mph mobility scooters thanks to low-profile tyres and A-frame suspension. Low-profile tyres with larger rims improve braking and traction, and the suspension protects you from bumpy terrain for a smooth journey free from aches and pains. This is a scooter packed with personality. Just look at the attention to detail in the unique shape of the wing mirrors and lighting. Or that classy leather seat, soft and supple and shaped for support in your lower back, with padded armrests and headrest for even more comfort. This sleek and sporty mobility scooter with an aerodynamic profile also features a sunlight-readable LCD display panel, to help you keep track of important info like current speed and battery level. The Corvus Rapide is sure to stand out around town.

The Corvus Rapide is fitted with a swivel captain seat for easy side transfers. The seat-sliding mechanism and backrest angle adjustment help you find the most comfortable position. There’s plenty of legroom for the longer-limbed out there, too.

You’ll find a backrest pocket and a front basket for storing all your essentials, as well as all the safety features you need for on-road journeys. products.body_html:
GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale this 2023 Li-Tech AIR + (Plus), a 4 mph super portable, lightweight, long-range mobility scooter that comes with fully tested 20ah lithium battery (in excellent order), charger, user manual and a 6-month warranty. Ask us about insurance and part exchange! 

Some of the great features include suspension, a 12-mile range, a 21-stone weight capacity, a swivel seat, solid tyres, on or off-board charging and comes apart into 5 parts (heaviest part only 15kgs!) for easy transportation for cars, buses and trains!

The cosmetic condition is excellent with some minor marks.

This portable scooter ticks all the boxes in our opinion!

FREE, fast nationwide delivery!

Manufacturers description:

The future has arrived and we like what we see! The Li-Tech Air Plus represents a new generation of mobility scooters. It’s lighter, better performing and faster to charge than anything that’s come before it, and it is all thanks to the lithium battery power at its heart. As well as the lighter weight and faster charging time, lithium-ion batteries last longer and deliver consistent performance even at low charge.

Lithium-ion technology is driving change across many areas of transport, and mobility aids are no exception. These power cells provide performance that is on another level compared with lead acid batteries. Small, light and with a faster charging time, they also deliver consistent performance regardless of the level of charge - so a battery that has two percent charge is just as powerful as one that is fully charged.

Intelligently designed for your comfort

Everything about the Li-Tech Air has been designed with your comfort and convenience in mind. The plush seat is generously padded and height adjustable, and it swivels to the side to make boarding and alighting as easy and safe as possible. Out and about, it’s incredibly easy to operate, even if you have limited grip and dexterity, thanks to large controls with great sensitivity. It’s ideal for those living with arthritis.


A smoother ride wherever you go

Li-Tech has taken the unusual step of incorporating all-round independent suspension on the Air. At least, it’s an unusual feature on a travel scooter. You'll really notice the difference as rattles and bumps are absorbed, and if you usually find travel scooters too uncomfortable due to vibrations being transmitted up your spine and leaving you black and blue, this one is definitely something you should try.

Perfect for regular trips in the car

The Air can be split into five components in no time, and it's just as easy to reassemble when you arrive at your destination. The heaviest part weighs a mere 15kg (33lb) so it’s manageable if you are travelling on your own. The design makes it easy to store out of the way when it’s not in use, too. Off-board charging means you can leave the scooter packed away while you take the battery pack indoors to charge.

Pride have now introduced the all new and stylish Go Go Endurance mobility scooter. With its sporty styling and innovative design, the Go Go Endurance is set to make its mark in the world of transportable mobility scooters.

Following on from the hugely successful range of Apex Rapid mobility scooters, the Go Go Endurance shares all the best features with some great additions. A rare feature for a scooter that goes in the boot of the car, Pride have equipped this latest model with their new “Comfort Trac” suspension system, known as CTS. This should soak up the bumps in the pavement and ensure your ride is as comfortable as possible. Standard features also include a soft touch wrap around delta tiller, a powerful LED kerb light and a high level charging point.

You will also get a comfortable swivel seat with a storage pouch at the rear, adjustable armrests that also flip up to aid getting on and off the scooter. The seat is available in either a 17″ width as standard, or you can select the wider 20″ version for added comfort if required. The scooter comes apart very easily to put in the boot of the car, separating into 5 sections. There are also two sets of coloured panels so you can change between grey and red as the mood takes you.

The Go Go Endurance makes use of up to date Lithium-ion battery technology. This means that the battery pack weighs a fraction of the weight of standard batteries and the battery should have a much longer life. products.body_html:
GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale this ex-display 2023 Zora Carbon Fibre Portable Powerchair. This is the world's lightest powerchair (12.7kgs!) but still has all the features that you would expect from a powerchair.

This powerchair is in excellent condition with some very minor marks to the footplate.

FREE, fast national delivery, mail-order part exchange available and a 6-month warranty that covers everything!

It includes the (tested) airline-friendly 10AH Lithium battery, solid tyres, supportive leg strap, transferable joystick (can be on either the left or right side), user manual and charger.

The lightest powerchair in the world! Coming in at a featherweight 12.7 kg, the Zora Carbon Powerchair weighs less than some manual wheelchairs but it pulls no punches when it comes to packing in the features. This groundbreaking lightweight powerchair takes its cues from the world of road bikes, with a frame crafted from carbon fibre for optimum strength and durability. And with airline-friendly batteries and quick and easy folding, this is one powerchair that really can go with you wherever you need it to.

Expert engineering and the latest technology means this powerchair weighs less than any other you’ll find on the market. The frame is made up entirely of carbon fibre, chosen for its impressive strength to weight ratio. Five-times stronger than steel and twice as stiff, it also resists corrosion and it doesn’t fatigue over time. The higher compression strength of carbon fibre coupled with the reinforced seat panel means that despite its lightweight build, this powerchair still supports up to 120 kg in weight. In short? The Zora is the way to go if you want a powerchair that will last.

That carbon fibre frame isn’t just functional – it looks extra special too. The Zora has a minimalist design but it maxes out the style, with the black-flecked carbon fibre frame looking smoother and sleeker than aluminium powerchairs. Flip up armrests allow for easier side transfers and the aerated backrest relieves pressure for longer journeys. The cushions are removable, too, so you can wash them when you need to.

The Zora Carbon houses a 10AH lithium-ion battery that charges quicker, lasts longer and weighs less than SLA batteries. On- and off-board charging add to the convenience, and at 240 watt hours it can be taken on a plane (but it’s always worth checking with your airline before flying).

products.body_html:
GMS Mobility is pleased to offer for sale, this fantastic value and very popular 2024 (sold new in 2025) X-Go Advance, a transportable 4-6 mph pavement/road medium-to-large size all-terrain mobility scooter that comes with fully tested 38ah batteries (in excellent order), charger, Free nationwide fast delivery, user manual and a 6-month scooter warranty included. Great value as the new RRP is £1999.99+VAT!

Details:

More style, substance and comfort than you can shake a stick at. The X-Go Advance helps you reclaim the roads with a massive range of nearly 25 miles, and it’s agile enough to go indoors where bigger scooters can’t. This scooter stays ahead of the pack with details that really do make a difference to your everyday.

Advance by name, advanced by nature

With full suspension, a wraparound delta tiller and a captain’s seat as comfy as one you’d find in a luxury car, the X-Go Advance leads the charge for modern day mobility scooters. Tackle rough and rugged terrain without a second thought, from the nearby field where you walk the dog to the potholed pavements of the high street. This pavement performer is a road reclaimer, too, with a max speed of up to 6 mph for those journeys further afield.

Set up to suit you in seconds

Almost everything about the X-Go Advance Mobility Scooter is adjustable. The armrests lift up and down with a squeeze of a lever, the headrest raises and lowers, the backrest can be reclined, and the seat can be brought closer to or moved further away from the tiller bar. And it’s not just about comfort – it makes getting on and off the scooter so much easier, for an all round boost to your independence while you’re out and about.

The smoother mover

Leave your aches and pains in the past. Suspension on the front and rear wheels counteracts the bone-rattling jolts of uneven ground, like cobbles and gravel. The wraparound delta tiller bar needs only one hand for close control, with levers that can be operated with just your thumb and fingers. Chunky 10 inch solid PU tyres and a ground clearance of 80mm take on tough terrain, while the 500W motor will power you up gradients of 10 degrees without breaking a sweat.

Lead the charge

The X-Go Advance is the modern day scooter, with details that stand out in a sea of uninspiring mobility design. A scooter like this deserves more than your standard reds and blues, so it’s finished in a striking Vapour Grey. Angled front headlights turn up the style and keep you safe and seen in low visibility, alongside angular rear view mirrors and a rear lighting design that takes its cue from modern day electric cars.

Manufacturers' general description and specs |(may differ, so please check images or contact us with any questions:

Designed to challenge indoor/outdoor powerchair standards, the Q100 R is ultra-compact for indoor agility, with stability and performance that‘s just as at home on the city streets. Smart design, smart looks - all at a smart price.

QUICKIE Q100 R uses an innovative testing method called SMART base technology. This helped us to understand how geometry changes to a drive base can affect performance, creating a precision-measured TRUE indoor/outdoor powerchair.

From SMART base development the Q100 R powerchair boasts an ultra-small footprint of 540 mm wide and 1010 mm long, with a tiny 1600 mm turning circle, so navigating even the tightest of spaces is a breeze.

SMART Base Technology

All indoor/outdoor powered wheelchairs face the same problem... We solved it with SMART BASE Technology.

Our vision was to create a TRUE indoor/outdoor powerchair with super-tight indoor manoeuvrability and no compromises on outdoor stability and performance. But how do you design such a delicately balanced powerchair?

A large drive-base means difficulty when manoeuvring in tight environments. Too small and it becomes tippy with a loss of traction. With SMART Base Technology we were able to test 100‘s of configurations to find the perfect combination.

The result is the QUICKIE SALSA Q100 R. A legitimately compact entry-level powerchair that delivers the very-best traction, stability and even the ability to climb kerbs of up to 100 mm (4“).

Designed to be in your space

Whether it’s around the home, the local café or shopping mall, the SALSA Q100 R is in-touch with its environment inside and out. With an ultra-slim base and tiny turning circle, even the smallest place will feel big.

So narrow-minded

Fed up of clipping the side of your powered wheelchair or scratching the paint work when squeezing through a tight doorway? The Q100R‘s ultra-slim base width of 540 mm can go where other indoor/outdoor powerchairs won‘t fit - so even negotiating narrow paths or packed tables at your favourite café will be a breeze.

The small powerchair that is big on going out

Popping out? The SALSA Q100 R‘s indoor capabilities are just as at home outdoors. Painstakingly researched, its compact dimensions provide highly deceptive traction and stability over a variety of terrains, hills and even when tackling kerbs.

Never an up-hill-struggle

Indoor/outdoor powerchairs don‘t traditionally cope well with steep gradients - a problem we solved with SMART Base Technology. Precision-testing determined that a 1010 mm base-length provides the best stability to prevent tipping and keep you safe - even when travelling up hills of 6 degrees.

SMART base technology helped to calculate not only the dimensions for a compact base, but also the ideal seated position for maximising traction between the drive-wheel and the ground. Combined with the Q100 R drive-wheel suspension, you‘ll enjoy the kind of safe, smooth and responsive ride that‘s normally expected from a larger powerchair.

Sit back and relax

The SALSA Q100R‘s seating has been designed to fit you. With plenty of settings and a 5-strap tension adjustable back to meet postural requirements, take comfort in knowing that if your needs change, so can your seat.

Move with the future. The AirFold Pro Carbon Scooter brings together all the latest technology to make your everyday life so much easier, with a carbon fibre frame that folds automatically in seconds. Sleek but strong and oh so stylish, this ultra-lightweight travel scooter only weighs 19.9kg, making it one of the lightest and most compact automatic folding scooters available.

Expert engineering for everyday travel

Taking all the benefits of futureproof carbon fibre and combining it with an auto-folding frame means the AirFold Pro strips all the hassle from your excursions. The folding mechanism can be activated in three ways: from the key, with a quick click on the remote control, or by tapping the contactless card. It’s all about giving you more time on the move, and less time faffing with awkward disassembly. Five-times stronger than steel and twice as stiff, the carbon fibre frame resists corrosion and fatigue over time, and it has a better strength to weight ratio compared with aluminium. So, despite the ultralight spec, the AirFold Pro can still support up to 125 kg in user weight.

Less weight, more features

The AirFold Pro Carbon Scooter is the result of ground breaking research into new materials and technical advancements, tapping into the potential of carbon fibre construction to deliver one of the lightest travel scooters available. But that’s not all. Your digital LCD screen helps you keep track of speed, battery power, travel time and mileage, with a USB port to top up your gadgets along the way. This is stripped back, forward-thinking mobility design.

Contactless convenience

The No time to spare? With one quick click, a tap or a turn of a key, your AirFold Pro folds up right before your eyes. It takes just 20 seconds, using a 2-stage process for maximum safety. You don’t need to worry about taking it all apart (or remembering how to put it back together again) – and at a manageable 19.9kg, you can lift and position it in your car boot without trouble.

Move with the future

There’s no underestimating just how important reliability is when it comes to your scooter batteries. The AirFold Pro uses the latest lithium-ion technology for batteries that are lighter, longer-lasting and quicker to charge. Perfect for travelling, whether you’re jetting off on holiday or commuting to work.

products.body_html:
This great value 2023 X-Go TravelPro (Red) comes in excellent condition as you would expect, and includes a charger, fully tested 15ah lithium battery (in excellent order), manual, a rear seat bag, free delivery and a 3-month warranty. Part exchange available. Ask us about Insurance.

Our new quick-folding, car boot-convenient lightweight mobility scooter. The X-Go TravelPro folds almost flat to fit where bigger scooters can’t, ideal for public transport and compact storage. 17.4 miles of uninterrupted travel.

The cosmetic condition is good with marks (please see images).

Great value as the new RRP is £2299+VAT!

Lightweight, lithium powered travel

With a heaviest piece of 21.5kg and a lithium-ion battery that weighs less than the sealed lead acid batteries on other models, the TravelPro makes everyday life with a scooter not just brighter, but lighter, too. Thoughtfully designed and cleverly built, this travel scooter folds almost to an almost flat 12” clearance with the seat removed – slide it into your car boot for days out, or an out-the-way storage space for days in. Plus, enjoy the peace of mind that comes with a lifetime warranty on the frame, keeping you on the move day in, day out.

Clever convenience

The X-Go TravelPro is expertly engineered to fit neatly into your everyday life. On the move, you’ll feel comfortable and stable every mile of the day. And when you need to pack it up for transport, it takes just a few seconds to drop the seat hinges and tiller bar. Integrated handles at the front and sides of the scooter mean you can wheel it along like a suitcase, and the weight of the scooter is distributed evenly – a massive help when you’re hoisting it into a car boot. Once the front wheels are on the car, just lift the back and wheel it into your boot. Safe, simple, car boot convenience.

You’re in control

With a small turning radius and simple tiller bar operation, the TravelPro keeps you in control. Narrow spaces, busy high streets and train stations are easy to deal with, while longer journeys are back on the cards thanks to the 17.4-mile high performance lithium-ion battery. There’s no shortage of comfort either – the tiller bar is infinitely adjustable thanks to the gas-strut design, so you can bring it closer or move it further away depending on the room you need, while the armrests can be moved to help you on and off the scooter seat with ease.

The lightest powerchair in the world! Coming in at a featherweight 13 kg, the Zora Carbon Powerchair weighs less than some manual wheelchairs but it pulls no punches when it comes to packing in the features. This ground-breaking lightweight powerchair takes its cues from the world of road bikes, with a frame crafted from carbon fibre for optimum strength and durability. And with airline-friendly batteries and quick and easy folding, this is one powerchair that really can go with you wherever you need it to.

Expert engineering and the latest technology means this powerchair weighs less than any other you’ll find on the market. The frame is made up entirely of carbon fibre, chosen for its impressive strength to weight ratio. Five-times stronger than steel and twice as stiff, it also resists corrosion and it doesn’t fatigue over time. The higher compression strength of carbon fibre coupled with the reinforced seat panel means that despite its lightweight build, this powerchair still supports up to 120 kg in weight. In short? The Zora is the way to go if you want a powerchair that will last.

That carbon fibre frame isn’t just functional – it looks extra special too. The Zora has a minimalist design but it maxes out the style, with the black-flecked carbon fibre frame looking smoother and sleeker than aluminium powerchairs. The half-folding backrest is perfect for quick and easy storage at home and stowage on planes, trains and automobiles, while the magnesium alloy wheels add yet another touch of class.

The Zora Carbon holds up just as well outdoors as it does gliding around indoors. The expertly engineered carbon fibre frame counteracts the discomfort of tough outdoor terrain like kerbs and cobbles, and the solid tyres mean there’s no chance of a puncture ruining your day. Flip up armrests allow for easier side transfers and the aerated backrest relieves pressure for longer journeys. The cushions are removable, too, so you can wash them when you need to.

The Zora Carbon houses a 10Ah lithium-ion battery that charges quicker, lasts longer and weighs less than SLA batteries. You’ll get 15 km on a full charge – but the batteries are light enough that you could carry a spare and double up your range. On- and off-board charging add to the convenience, and at 240 watt hours it can be taken on a plane (but it’s always worth checking with your airline before flying).

GMS Mobility are pleased to offer for sale this ex demo late 2025 Li-Tech Neon 15, 4 mph super portable, mobility scooter which comes with charger, a fully tested 20ah lithium battery pack (in excellent condition - as new), a user manual and a 6-month warranty.
